messages:
rachel_sales: Acme POC asks for a concise SOW line for USB delivery: signing, SBOM, hotfix SLA, billing on delivery vs apply. Need an ops checklist and contract bullets.
devon_se: We support HSM-signed detached sigs + per-file SHA256 manifest. Two signing flows: Redwood-sign (we sign, customer imports root) or customer-sign kit (they sign locally).
ola_sre: Ops: require pre-apply snapshot + rollback token. Recommend chunked parts (<=50GB), resumable apply utility. Verify example:
```
sha256sum -c redwood.manifest && openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.part1
```
henry_legal: Contract language: emergency signed artifact within 24h available on enterprise SLA with expedited fee; Redwood not liable for transit. Include chain-of-custody acceptance and export-control note.
courier-bot: ticket SALES-8344 created: deliverables (1-page ops checklist, SOW snippets, expedited-fee table).
rachel_sales: Please drop drafts here by EOD, will send to Acme. :pray:
